residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0023/IMP-0078/IMP-0084 catalog units are not separately delivered; this unit implements the handoff consumer plus the minimum plugin placement plane and the four verify gates it must run before that handoff.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-bind verify.py to IMP-0078/IMP-0084 modules when those units exist.

retry.policy: two-strikes-then-pivot; a verification failure never retries

reviewer.notes: Confirm verification order places lockfile digest and signature checks before deliver()/extract; marketplace has no extractall.

legacy_root.question_or_target: Implement marketplace-side install as fetch, verify (signature, revocation, lockfile digest, compatibility), then HAND OFF to the Phase-5 plugin installer through the typed handoff contract — never reimplementing file placement, so there is exactly one installer control plane.
legacy_root.title: Marketplace install operation delegating to the plugin installer
